department: Astrophysics Graduate Program / Astronomy and Astrophysics of the Paris Region (ED 127 AAIF)

deadline.value: Standard 3-year PhD enrollment runs September 1 to mid-December after supervisor, funding, and doctoral-school jury selection; Fall 2027 doctoral-contract competition dates are not yet published (separate 5-year Bachelor-entry PhD Track call runs Oct 14 - Dec 14, 2026).
deadline.quote: This generally takes place from September 1st until mid-December for the current year.

gre_subject.value: No GRE Subject Test requirement is stated on the Astrophysics Graduate Program or ED 127 AAIF pages.

supervisor.value: Doctoral candidates must obtain agreement from an accredited dissertation advisor (HDR) and admission to a PSL-affiliated research unit before enrolling.
supervisor.quote: Before enrolling in the program, doctoral students must obtain approval from their dissertation advisor and be admitted to a research unit or team that belongs to a PSL-accredited or co-accredited doctoral school.

funding.value: Doctoral contracts are allocated competitively via Graduate Program and Doctoral School juries (alongside CIFRE industrial agreements, ANR/agency grants, and international fellowships); secured 3-year funding is generally required to enroll in science/engineering schools.
funding.quote: Each graduate program assigns doctoral contracts to doctoral schools accredited or co-accredited by Université PSL and affiliated with the graduate program. | Doctoral school students are selected by a jury usually comprised of PSL faculty and external members.

also.quote: Ils préparent en 3 ans et en étant rémunérés par des contrats divers, un doctorat dans des laboratoires situés en Ile-de-France ou parfois à l’étranger.

entry_route.value: A Master's degree or equivalent is required for standard 3-year PhD admission under French national doctoral regulations (Article 10) and constituent-school rules; PSL also offers a separate 5-year Bachelor-entry PhD Track in select Graduate Programs.
entry_route.quote: Chaque année, l’Ecole doctorale accueille environ 50 nouveaux étudiants issus de Masters ou équivalent, sans condition de nationalité ni d’université d’origine.

notes: Led by Observatoire de Paris - PSL and ENS - PSL through ED 127 AAIF (Astronomy and Astrophysics of Île-de-France) and ED 564 PIF. Also offers a 5-year Bachelor-entry PSL PhD Track in Astrophysics.
